titulo: The customer you lose without knowing it
hooks: The customer you lost without knowing
What do your referrals find when they look?
Referred, looked you up, picked someone else
voz: Someone recommends you. That person looks you up on their phone before reaching out. If they find nothing, or an old website that won't load, they move on to the next one on the list. You never find out, but that customer was already yours.

bloques.frase: an old website that won't load
the next one on the list

visual.texto: So they pick the next one

captions: The sales you lose don't show up as complaints. They're people who looked you up, didn't find anything clear and messaged someone else.
You earned that recommendation. Whether the referred person finds you and trusts you depends on what they see when they look you up.
Try this: search for your business on your phone like you're a new customer. What you see is what they see.
